about: The collecta of the formulary “Sunday after the Ascension” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Almighty and everlasting God, grant that our will may always be devoted to You and that we may always serve Your majesty with a sincere heart. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: ever have a will devoted to You
serve Your majesty with a sincere heart
